---
title: "Dataset Viewer"
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    page-layout: full
---

<div id="dataset-viewer">
  <p id="status">Loading dataset...</p>
  <div id="table-container"></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/papaparse@5.4.1/papaparse.min.js"></script>

<script>
const datasets = {
  "closed-public-schools": {
    title: "Closed Public Schools",
    file: "data/Closed_Public_Schools.csv"
  },
  "dc-assessment-results": {
    title: "DC Public Schools Assessment Results",
    file: "data/DC_Public_Schools_Student_Assessment_Results.csv"
  },
  "hbcu-data": {
    title: "HBCU Data",
    file: "data/hbcu_data.csv"
  },
  "independent-schools": {
    title: "Independent Schools",
    file: "data/Independent_Schools.csv"
  },
  "president-data": {
    title: "Data on U.S. Presidents",
    file: "data/president.csv"
  },
  "yahoo-policing-data": {
    title: "Yahoo! Policing Data",
    file: "data/race_justice.csv"
  },
  "racism-in-stem": {
    title: "Racism in STEM Bibliometric Data",
    file: "data/racism-in-stem.txt"
  },
  "state-district-data": {
    title: "State District Data",
    file: "data/state-district-data.csv"
  },
  "us-state-data": {
    title: "US State Data",
    file: "data/us-state-data.csv"
  }
};

const parameters = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const datasetId = parameters.get("dataset");
const dataset = datasets[datasetId];

const status = document.getElementById("status");
const container = document.getElementById("table-container");

if (!dataset) {
  status.textContent = "Dataset not found.";
} else {
  document.title = dataset.title;
  status.textContent = `Loading ${dataset.title}...`;

  Papa.parse(dataset.file, {
    download: true,
    header: true,
    skipEmptyLines: true,
    complete: function(results) {
      const rows = results.data;
      const columns = results.meta.fields;

      if (!rows.length || !columns.length) {
        status.textContent = "This dataset is empty or could not be read.";
        return;
      }

      status.innerHTML = `
        <h2>${dataset.title}</h2>
        <p>
          Showing ${rows.length.toLocaleString()} rows and
          ${columns.length.toLocaleString()} columns.
          <a href="${dataset.file}" download>Download the CSV</a>.
        </p>
      `;

      const table = document.createElement("table");
      table.className = "table table-striped table-hover table-sm";

      const thead = document.createElement("thead");
      const headerRow = document.createElement("tr");

      columns.forEach(function(column) {
        const cell = document.createElement("th");
        cell.textContent = column;
        headerRow.appendChild(cell);
      });

      thead.appendChild(headerRow);
      table.appendChild(thead);

      const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");

      rows.forEach(function(row) {
        const tableRow = document.createElement("tr");

        columns.forEach(function(column) {
          const cell = document.createElement("td");
          cell.textContent = row[column] ?? "";
          tableRow.appendChild(cell);
        });

        tbody.appendChild(tableRow);
      });

      table.appendChild(tbody);

      const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
      wrapper.style.overflowX = "auto";
      wrapper.appendChild(table);

      container.appendChild(wrapper);
    },
    error: function() {
      status.textContent = "The dataset could not be loaded.";
    }
  });
}
</script>
